private_note: Owner's decision 2026-11-24: the member lifts (Village, Mary's, Raintree, Primetime Express; Foxtrot, drawn for the 26/27 season) are hidden, and so is every run reached only from them (Primetime and Raintree areas) or leading only to them (Mary's Bowl). Lefty's Canyon stays: the trail map shows uptracks out of it (config links). Runs taken off 'runs' with their map rating: B Roll 2, Big Gulp 1, Bird's Eye 2, Bounce Board 2, CRISPR 1, Call Sheet 1, Cherry Ridge 1, Cliffhanger 2, Close Up 2, Dolly 2, Double Take 2, Ebb 2, Final Cut 2, Flow 2, Golden Hour 2, Grey Cliff 2, Hairy Mary 1, Hippie Hill 2, Jump Cut 2, Little Stumpy 2, Long Goodbye 1, Martini Shot 2, Mirage 1, On Air 2, Overlook 0, Pickup 2, Pilot 0, Plot Twist 2, Raintree 1, Send It 2, Serenity 0, Showrunner 2, Star Crossed 0, Studio 1 2, Studio 2 2, Studio 3 2, Stumpy's 2, Super Frank! 3, Take 1 2, Take 2 2, Technocrane 3, Thunderdome 3, White Room 3, Wildflower 1. OpenStreetMap draws Wonderland from the top of Mary's along the ridge before it drops into Mary's Bowl: that upper part is where Lay of the Land, Bluebell, Yin and Yang start (2026 trail map), so the config splits it off as Lay of the Land and only the Mary's Bowl part is hidden. Also hidden: the east side of Lefty's Canyon, which starts at the top of Village (Easy Peasy 0, Flanders 1, Vern's Bowl 1, Enchanted Forest 1, Middle Kingdom 1, RK 1)
